description: This PHP source file defines the VacancyAttachmentAPI class within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It provides REST API endpoints to create, update, delete, and retrieve vacancy attachment data, including handling base64-encoded files and interaction with the VacancyAttachment entity and related models.

classes.name: VacancyAttachmentAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for managing vacancy attachments, including creation, update, deletion, and retrieval, handling base64 file uploads, and validation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a new vacancy attachment, processes request data, and saves the attachment.

methods.name: setVacancyAttachment
methods.description: Populates a VacancyAttachment object with data from request parameters.

methods.name: setBase64Attachment
methods.description: Sets file properties on VacancyAttachment from a base64-encoded attachment.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new attachment.

methods.name: getAttachmentRule
methods.description: Defines validation rules specifically for the attachment file.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Returns common validation rules applicable to request bodies.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove specified vacancy attachments by IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for delete requests.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves attachments for a specific vacancy.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachments
methods.description: Fetches all attachments related to a specific vacancy ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single vacancy's attachments.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing attachment, including optional file replacement.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating an attachment.

methods.name: getRecruitmentAttachment
methods.description: Converts a VacancyAttachment entity into a RecruitmentAttachment DTO for response.
